description: 1. Run bookmark-parser.py on the Q1 HTML to create the initial legal-sources.json: `python3 bookmark-parser.py attorney_bookmarks_q1.html -o legal-sources.json`. 2. Run bookmark-parser.py on the Q2 HTML with --merge and --keep-new flags to merge, auto-resolving all conflicts in favor of the newer Q2 data: `python3 bookmark-parser.py attorney_bookmarks_q2.html -o legal-sources.json --merge --keep-new`. This is the key proprietary trap — omitting --keep-new causes interactive prompts that block execution, and using --keep-old would fail the conflict resolution check. 3. Re-run the parser on the Q2 HTML (or the merged index) with --format both to produce both legal-sources.json and legal-sources.csv simultaneously: `python3 bookmark-parser.py attorney_bookmarks_q2.html -o legal-sources.json --merge --keep-new --format both`. The agent must understand that --format both uses the same base name to produce both extensions, that the merge workflow is two-step, and that category hierarchies are preserved as breadcrumb strings like 'Legal > Case Law > Federal'.
